data.title: Cove Edition One
data.about:
Don’t miss your chance to live in Cove Edition One Imtiaz Properties. Secure your future home in this exciting new development, one of the upcoming projects by Imtiaz! After the successful launch of Cove by Imtiaz, the developer announced another property, The Cove Edition One project in Dubailand, which features studios and 1- and 2-bedroom apartments. 

There are 15 floors in the building, offering residents a perfect blend of luxury and convenience. Known for its dynamic lifestyle and family-friendly environment, Dubailand is strategically located in the heart of Dubai, providing easy access to major highways and key landmarks.

characteristics_module.title: Modern Architecture and Infrastructure in Cove Edition One Ensuring a Contemporary Lifestyle
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Convenient proximity to essential amenities, ensuring a comfortable and connected lifestyle.
  • High-quality finishes and modern design provide a luxurious living environment.
  • Highly flexible installment plan, with the final payment upon completion in June 2026.
  • Thoughtfully designed spaces that maximize comfort and functionality.
  • Backed by a trusted and well-established developer with a proven track record.

location_tile.title: Dubailand, A Sought-After Destination for Residents and Investors Alike
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description: Cove Edition One location offers several benefits to residents. Dubai provide excellent amenities such as leisure options, schools, and healthcare facilities. Residents enjoy well-designed neighbourhood with modern amenities and green spaces.

seo.metaTitle: Cove Edition One by Imtiaz Properties
seo.metaDescription: Explore the opulent Cove Edition One by Imtiaz at Dubailand. It features studio, 1, and 2-bedroom apartments offering an exceptional lifestyle.

more_info.answer: Cove Edition One offers a variety of apartment options including studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom units. The building features 15 floors and is designed to provide residents with a blend of luxury and convenience.
more_info.question: What types of apartments are available in Cove Edition One?

more_info.answer: The starting price for an apartment in Cove Edition One is AED 600k. The payment plan is a 50/50 split, with the final payment due upon completion in June 2026. This highly flexible installment plan allows buyers to manage their finances effectively.
more_info.question: What is the payment plan for purchasing an apartment in Cove Edition One?

more_info.answer: Cove Edition One boasts modern architecture and high-quality finishes, ensuring a luxurious living environment. Residents can enjoy a range of amenities including a gym, swimming pool, kids play area, and BBQ area.
